title: Why Aren’t Stocks Plunging?
text:
Why Aren’t Stocks Plunging?

Didier Darcet

Gavekal-IS | 8 Oct 2026

The start of autumn is often a worrying time for investors, and 2026 is no different. Clouds are gathering over the global economy. The Strait of Hormuz and the Bab al Mandab are blocked—or at least severely disrupted. Crude oil is at US$90/bbl for WTI. Inflationary pressures are building. Short-term and long-term interest rates are rising. The perfect cocktail for a stock-market crash.Yet the market is doing the opposite. Since hostilities erupted in the Persian Gulf on February 28, global equities—as measured by the MSCI World index—have risen 9%. So what does the market see as positive in the current situation?
